name: test-beatfx
title: Builder A: the beat track over the real prelude (short cut, edit 0-17.0 = song 6.10-23.10): gentle 'prelude' accents on the pad's swells, then the drop riff
_note: Items 0-13.13 are copied from edl/short.json (the prelude montage: Altman, Amodei, two headlines, the breath line); the legacy logo formation is replaced by the kand 'riff' preset. song/hits.json says the prelude has NO tempo-locked pulse (a pad with an irregular ~1.7 Hz swell), so the prelude track uses "grid": "pulse" (hits.json prelude_pulse: swell peaks with a strength) instead of the beat grid, and the gentle pattern (soft blooms, grain on the ground, pencil ticks in the margins, small zoom pulses; no shake, no splat, no colour flip over footage). Calm 'auto': the 0.4 s after each headline enters gets only grain/ticks/small punches. Render: python3 render/video/render.py beats test-beatfx --from 0 --to 17; prep the clips first if cache/ is empty (python3 render/video/prep_clips.py test-beatfx).

audio.note: SPLICED. Edit time = song time - 6.10 up to the splice at edit 20.377 (song 26.477), then song time - 44.811 (song 65.188 on). The 'song' block below is what mix.py plays; songStart only holds before the splice. Clip speech: the montage (edit 0-8.43; Olivia's spoken line starts at 11.56) and Bostrom over the closing instrumental.

song.note: Splice riff beat 15 -> refrain bar 23 beat 4 (same bar phase, 20 bars = 38.711 s). Not on a bar line: bar 23's downbeat is inside 'upset' (vocal to ~64.2) and bar 24's is inside the pickup 'They say' (from ~65.43). bar_tol_ms 70 because bars.json runs ~25 ms late and both cut points sit 15-20 ms before the beat's attack, by design (out/NOTES.md).

caption.text: …I think AI will probably like most likely sort of lead to the end of the world…

items._note: r4: footage + his own voice replace the silent quote card (all three short critics). r6: verbatim (small.en and base.en on the exact window, 3/3 each): 'I think AI will probably like most likely sort of lead to the end of the world'; the leading … marks the cut 'You know,', the trailing … the sentence going on ('but in the meantime, there will be great companies created with serious machine learning'). rev2: the backdrop (the event's cyan wall with yellow speaker credits, 'Airbnb' among them) is shown as filmed (the r4 key is removed). Year only (the month rests on Business Insider's Jun 4, 2015 report). Audio: a quiet recording with a 21 dB peak-to-loudness ratio, so a per-clip peak limiter (peak_rel_db 14) keeps it from capping the whole mix's loudness.
